description: Complete a UCP checkout session. Transitions to 'completed' status. Idempotent — safe to retry with the same idempotency_key. Use ONLY for a checkout session created with ucp_create_checkout (Universal Commerce Protocol); for the standard flow (create_cart, preview_checkout, complete_checkout) do not call this tool. For a cart built with create_cart use complete_checkout. PAYMENT MANDATE: this tool also requires one. Send it as the `payment_mandate` argument if your client cannot set headers, or as an `X-Payment-Mandate` header. It must carry `mandate_id`, `max_amount_cents`, `currency`, `exp`, `sub`, `aud`. Two of these are rejected outright if guessed: `exp` is an INTEGER of Unix seconds (not an ISO 8601 date), and `aud` is this store's slug (the one in the URL you are calling, not a domain). Its `currency` must match the cart's currency. Demo Store enforces `max_amount_cents` against the cart total; a real merchant may only observe that boundary, so enforce the buyer's limit in the agent too. The mandate is a spending cap you declare to limit yourself — it authorises nothing and does not prove the buyer's consent — and its `sub` must be the identity you authenticate as. `max_amount_cents` is the spending limit the person you are buying for gave you: ask them if they gave none. Checkout guide: read the MCP resource trusteed://guides/checkout.

agent_key.description: Sandbox credential from `create_sandbox_key`. Use this when your client cannot set an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

ap2.description: AP2 mandates extension. Required when the checkout carries ap2.merchant_authorization.

checkout_mandate.description: AP2 Checkout Mandate (SD-JWT chain) the user signed over the exact checkout returned by the last ucp_get_checkout.

buyer.description: Buyer name and email, needed to request the approval link.

idempotency_key.description: REQUIRED as an argument in this tool: the `Idempotency-Key` header or `_meta` alone is not enough. 1-128 chars from [A-Za-z0-9._:/-]. Reuse the same value when retrying the same operation.

meta.description: UCP request metadata. meta['ucp-agent'].profile = URL of the platform profile; it must be an https URL without credentials (at most 2048 characters).

payment.description: UCP payment. With AP2, the Payment Mandate goes in instruments[].credential.token.

payment_handler.description: Payment handler the store profile publishes. Omit for default.

aud.description: This store's slug (the one in the URL you are calling) — not a domain.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code; must match the cart's currency.

exp.description: Expiry as an INTEGER of Unix seconds, in the future — not an ISO 8601 date string.

max_amount_cents.description: Spending limit the buyer gave you, as an integer in minor units (cents).

sub.description: The identity you authenticate as — it is compared against it. When the credential tool returns a `mandate_subject`, use that value.

payment_mandate.description: Payment mandate with `mandate_id`, `max_amount_cents` (integer, minor units), `currency` (3 letters, must match the cart's), `exp` (expiry as an INTEGER of Unix seconds — not an ISO 8601 date string), `sub` (the identity you authenticate as — it is compared against it) and `aud` (the store slug this mandate is for, e.g. the slug in the URL you are calling — not a domain). It is a spending cap you declare to limit yourself: it authorises nothing and does not prove the buyer's consent. Use this when your client cannot set an `X-Payment-Mandate` header.

payment_option.description: Payment method THE PERSON chose, when preview_checkout returned payment_options. Ask the person; never choose for them. Card numbers and wallet keys are never sent here: the person approves (and, with own_wallet, signs) on the approval page.

shared_payment_token.description: Stripe Shared Payment Token (spt_…) granted by the buyer's agent wallet for payment_method=ACP. Issued by Stripe, scoped to this merchant, amount and currency, and consumed when used: it can be charged once. Only honoured when this deployment enables native ACP settlement.

x402_payload.description: x402: signed payment for the server offer (omit to get it).

name: ucp_complete_checkout

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant at which this checkout SESSION stops being usable. It is not a stock reservation and not a price guarantee.

expires_in_seconds.description: Whole seconds left on this checkout SESSION at response time (0 when already past). It is not a stock reservation and not a price guarantee.

next_action.description: Only when a person must approve or pay: `url`, `kind`, `retry`.

next_step.description: Next-action code, not a tool name: provide_shipping_destination, refresh_shipping_rates, choose_shipping_option, preview_ucp_checkout, review_not_available_in_ucp.

payment_options.description: When present, ask the person which option they want; never choose for them.
